reason: A read-only Web GUI panel for browsing global and session-visible skills, viewing derived loading states, and inspecting skill documentation and referenced text resources.

summaries.zh: 这是一个在 Web GUI 中以只读方式展示全局及当前会话可见技能、加载状态和技能文档的面板插件。
summaries.en: A read-only Web GUI panel for viewing global and session-visible skills, derived loading states, skill documentation, and referenced text resources.

capabilities: Displays global and session-visible skill catalogs in a Web GUI
Derives skill loading states from session events and logs
Reads skill documentation and explicitly referenced local UTF-8 text files through constrained read-only endpoints
Automatically refreshes displayed catalog data every 15 seconds
